evidence: Clear 4-layer package structure: controller / service / repository / model + util
Single deployable unit built via spring-boot-maven-plugin
No service discovery (no Eureka, Consul, or Kubernetes configs)
No message broker (no Kafka, RabbitMQ, or JMS in pom.xml or application.yaml)
No event-driven patterns (@EventHandler, @KafkaListener, etc.) in source code
@RestController exposes REST API (no Thymeleaf/JSP views — API-only)
